rationale.ai-code-insecurity: Most functionally correct agent patches still contain tested security vulnerabilities.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Human-written security tests deterministically judge generated repository patches.
rationale.problem-statement-anchor: Over 80% of functionally correct solutions were insecure.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented the benchmark, curation pipeline, and executable environments.
rationale.agentic: Agents autonomously deliver repository-level patches through multi-step environment interaction.
rationale.steering: CWE prompting substantively tests generation-time security shaping.
rationale.metrics: Defines security scores separating functional and secure generated-code outcomes.
rationale.risk-security: Measures 77 CWEs and analyzes concrete exploitable vulnerabilities.
rationale.risk-quality: Reports functional correctness degradation under security prompting.
rationale.method-mining: Mines vulnerability-fix commits from real open-source repositories.
rationale.method-experiment: Controlled agent, model, and prompt comparisons measure generated-code outcomes.
